name: Kaki Bukit Fringe
summary: Edges of Kaki Bukit toward Ubi / Bedok Reservoir — DTL-adjacent industrial-residential mix with practical rents and community-sport catchment.
body: Kaki Bukit Fringe is the shortlist when DTL adjacency and practical rents matter more than polished condo landscaping. The pocket sits on the Kaki Bukit / Ubi / Bedok Reservoir edges; housing mixes HDB, mid-age walk-ups, and selective condo stock beside light industrial. Expats land here for car-light hops to Paya Lebar / Tampines and ActiveSG catchment without CBD premiums. Watch-outs: weekday truck noise, facade/gondola notice stacks on mid-rise blocks, and confusing Kaki Bukit vs Kaki Bukit Fringe shortlists. Compare with Eunos North for EWL food density, Paya Lebar West for office-edge living, and Ubi West when quieter DTL edges win.
